description: Passionate storyteller and mathematics student dedicated to uncovering the history of space exploration. I focus on transforming technical data and space heritage into engaging, emotional narratives for our NASA Space Apps project.
summary:
What We Developed:
 We created Whispers of the Lost Objects, an illustrated science-fiction story blending real NASA history with human emotion. It follows Commander Sebastian and his crew on a Mars mission struck by a sudden navigation failure. In a vivid vision, Sebastian meets the "voices" of dormant NASA relics—Sojourner, Ingenuity, Perseverance’s heat shield, Deep Space 2, and Insight—before a crash leaves the crew stranded on Mars.
How It Addresses the Challenge: 
Space history and deep-space hazards often feel overly technical and distant. Our story transforms real mission hardware into relatable voices, allowing readers to experience their scientific milestones and communication blackouts firsthand. Simultaneously, it highlights the intense technical and emotional risks of interplanetary travel through the crew's emergency and Sebastian’s promise to his family back on Earth.
Why It Is Important: 
Silent spacecraft on Mars are never failures; they are pioneers that paved the way for human exploration. By honoring the legacy of past robotic missions alongside the courage of future astronauts, this project makes space history accessible, inspires curiosity, and reminds us that every lost object carries the enduring spirit of human discovery.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:
Whispers of the Lost Objects is an illustrated science-fiction story that brings real NASA Mars hardware to life. Following Commander Sebastian and his crew after a sudden deep-space navigation failure, the story gives a voice to dormant Martian relics—including Sojourner, Ingenuity, Perseverance’s heat shield, Deep Space 2, and Insight—before a crash leaves the crew stranded on Mars.

Benefits & Intended Impact:
Space data often feels overly technical. By turning historical missions and deep-space hazards into an emotional narrative, our project inspires public curiosity, honors past robotic pioneers, and reminds readers that "lost" spacecraft are vital stepping stones for future human exploration.

Creativity, Factors Considered & Tools:
We blended authentic NASA mission history (dates, lifespans, and communication blackouts) with personal stakes, personifying each spacecraft based on its real fate. Developed using chatgpt , inshot, microsoft word , powerpoint.
